title: Refine Details Panel Empty-State Styling for Editable Value Controls
description: Refine the global compose/sketchpad Details panel empty-state styling for editable value-side controls in the right-side property inspector. Any editable field/control on the value side that currently has no value should render in a muted/grayed state while empty (compose styling), but it must remain fully editable. As soon as the user focuses, types, or the control has a real value, it should return to the normal active styling automatically. Apply generically across editable Input, Textarea, Combobox, Slider, and Stepper value display used in TreeRow/TreeItem property rows. Keep all layout unchanged. Do not treat empty editable fields as disabled or readOnly.
summary: Re-applied all changes after discard. Added PropertyValueColumnContext (boolean React context, true inside Label's property-control div). Applied empty-state muted opacity (0.6) to Input (via input-root), Textarea (via textarea-root), Combobox (via ButtonGroup style), Stepper (via stepper-group), and Slider (via slider-content) when inside a property value column AND empty/undefined AND not focused/active. Opacity returns to 1 on focus, interaction, or when value is present. Controls outside Label are unaffected. Added 4 tests covering Input, Textarea, Combobox, and Stepper empty vs filled vs standalone cases. All 29 tests pass.
